race.description: Your Next Stop Wests Illawarra Provincial (Bm64)
race.comment: TEQUISODA (3) would definitely be at his best over longer however he is a winner over this course and distance first up before. Will get a similar run to that occasion as well. Does seem well placed after the claim to get the softest run and be right in it. CAP D'AIL (2) has been around the mark in all his form this campaign. He hasn't drawn the best which hurts but can still take up a forward position. ALL MACHIAVELLIAN (6) comes off a short break and a long time between wins. His best would be fighting this out. BANG ON TIME (8) has to be ready now after three efforts. The market seems to keep finding her.
